2099-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

3899-7084-7889.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2893-3470-6763-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2313-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

5147-5544-6462.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting any opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers when you commit the crime in step 1, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

719-4997-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
719-4997-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

240-5470-6633-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1169-1453-2387-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1169-1453-2387-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

1734-4605-6797-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1734-4605-6797-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

3534-5686-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
3534-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
3534-5686-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

339-677-4785-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4499-5261-6587-6588.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

1170-3363-4908-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

7-3705-5231-5997.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1594-3682-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

997-2281-2757-5006.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
997-2281-2757-5006.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Adrix and Nev

178-851-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
178-851-5361.description:
Declare Auton Soldier as an attacker.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability and Adeline trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, creating four token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Adrix and Nev attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the Adeline trigger, creating 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you control) 1/1 Human creature tokens tapped and attacking each opponent.

1819-5510-5511-5512.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of copies of Relentless Rats in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
1819-5510-5511-5512.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Relentless Rats from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Relentless Rats in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Relentless Rats as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
During the next player's turn, cast Surgical Extraction by paying {B/P}, exiling all copies of Relentless Rats from your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

917-2713-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You have no cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
917-2713-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Idle Thoughts by paying {1}, causing you to draw a cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana producing permanent.
Repeat.

2724-3632-3987.description:
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, triggering its first ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta enters the battlefield, but its first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

796-1762-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Zombie creature.
796-1762-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by  sacrificing a Zombie creature, adding one mana of any color.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Repeat.

1067-3525-4290.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Sculptor of Winter.
Sculptor of Winter does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1067-3525-4290.description:
Activate a land you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Rimefeather Owl by paying {1}{S}, putting a snow counter on the land, causing the land to become a snow permanent.
Activate Sculptor of Winter by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Sculptor of Winter.
Activate the land with the snow counter on it by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

1030-1651-3263-4659-4840.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1651-3263-4659-4840.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myr tokens, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

1445-1819-4651.notablePrerequisites:
Phyresis attached to Syr Konrad.
One additional creature card in your graveyard.
One additional creature card in hand.
1445-1819-4651.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
The creature card is put into your graveyard, triggering Syr Konrad, causing it to deal one infect damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
The creature card leaves your graveyard, triggering Syr Konrad, causing it to deal one infect damage to each opponent.
Repeat four more times.

1645-3284-3809.description:
Cast Crown of Flames for {R}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Korvold triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and drawing a card.
Activate Crown of Flames for {R}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

2713-3652-4050-5222.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Ornithopter.
2713-3652-4050-5222.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Phyrexian Altar to add {W}.
Sword of the Realms returns Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter.
Pay {W} to equip Sword of the Realms to Ornithopter.
Repeat.

721-2724-3036.notablePrerequisites: Wizard Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
721-2724-3036.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning itself and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat.

4659-4702-4853.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Dross Scorpion.
Dross Scorpion does not have summoning sickness.
4659-4702-4853.description:
Activate Dross Scorpion by tapping it, creating a copy of it with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Dross Scorpion copy, adding {C}{C}.
The Dross Scorpion copy dies, triggering itself and every Dross Scorpion on the battlefield.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping the Dross Scorpion enchanted by Splinter Twin.
Activate the Dross Scorpion enchanted by Splinter Twin by tapping it, creating a copy of it with haste.
Repeat steps 4-5 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
